name: runtime
description: Runtime operator control plane for agentic-plugins host readiness, doctor diagnostics, settings planning, workflow storage migration, consensus artifacts, worktree planning, context hygiene artifacts and explicit budget checks, completion footers, model/effort config, companion readiness, and workflow ledger health. L1 framework primitive per ADR-0024.

interface.shortDescription: Runtime diagnostics, settings planning, migration, consensus, worktree, and context artifacts
interface.longDescription: L1 framework primitive per ADR-0024. Provides $runtime:doctor as a read-only diagnostic surface for Claude Code and Codex CLI availability, auth state, marketplace/cache/plugin discovery, companion contract compatibility, model/effort resolution observation, explicit read-only sandbox/permission probe output, and engineer/orchestrator workflow plus peer-run ledger health. Provides $runtime:settings as a dry-run settings planner with explicit --apply writes limited to agentic-plugins-owned .agentic-plugins/config.toml model/effort defaults. Provides $runtime:migrate workflow-storage as an explicit ADR-0025 dry-run/apply surface that moves generated legacy .claude/agentic-* workflow state into .agentic-plugins/state/<plugin> only when blockers are clear. Provides $runtime:consensus as a dynamic peer consensus scaffold with an explicit companion executor: plan peer prompts, run companion dispatch only with execute --execute, store raw peer outputs as files, synthesize summary/disagreements/evidence pointers, and plan bounded targeted rebuttal rounds. Provides $runtime:worktree as a read-only planner for isolating non-trivial follow-up slices in dedicated git worktrees without mutating git state. Provides $runtime:context as a runtime-owned context hygiene scaffold that writes bounded summary/risk/next-session artifacts under .agentic-plugins/runs/context and runs read-only explicit budget checks without mutating host session context. Provides a script-level completion footer helper for pointer-only workflow handoff. Completion footer mutation, automatic unbounded consensus loops, automatic context mutation/capture triggers, and automatic plugin install/update apply mode are deferred.
